evidence_policy: Only exact identifiers with dated role assertions can support an address label. Explorer records are transaction evidence, not independent victim/device evidence. No-result searches and provider failures leave labels unknown.
publication: Cohort IDs, identifier hashes, query hashes, evidence URLs and adjudication only. Raw queries/response evidence stay local; no new bulk list of alleged victims.
requirement: Address-level adjudication of compromise, hardware seed origin and event signing, after complete source-history recovery.
selection: The first five records in the already frozen SHA256 cohort order; fixed before public searches, without replacing unsuccessful searches.
split_policy: No training or test split; one incident; source-report dates must be recorded separately from transaction cutoffs.
target_policy: Compromise, hardware seed origin and signing-device use are distinct. No negative controls or classifier fitting are introduced.
